alert.description: Margin-ruled note for info, warnings and errors.

badge.description: Manila tags, inked rubber stamps and highlighter swipes.

button.description: Interactive stamp that presses flat when clicked.

card.description: A sheet of cardstock with optional texture, tape, dog-ear, fold, rough cut or stack.

checkbox.description: Native checkbox with a hand-drawn tick.

input.description: Boxed field or single notebook rule.

paper-clip.description: Wire paper clip that pins a card or note.

separator.description: Perforated, dotted, solid or double rule.

sticky-note.description: Tilted sticky note, optionally taped down.

tape.description: Washi, scotch or kraft tape with torn ends.
